core.quote: Rollin' (Korean: 롤린) is a song by South Korean girl group Brave Girls.

story.quote: A sleeper hit, "Rollin initially failed to chart in South Korea following its release.

story.text: 4년 뒤 2021년 2월 군 장병 앞 공연 모음 영상이 퍼지며 역주행
story.quote: Four years later, the song experienced a sudden surge in popularity when a compilation video of Brave Girls performing it for the South Korean military went viral in the country in February 2021.
It soon became a nationwide hit, and achieved number one on both the Gaon Digital Chart and the K-pop Hot 100

hintIdea.quote: On August 11, 2018, the group released "Rollin' (New Version)", a rearranged version of the song, as a gift to fans for their passionate support of the song over the course of the previous year and a half.

items.why: 발표 4년 뒤 군 장병 영상 하나로 1위까지 간 역주행의 대표 사례

core.quote: "Tell Me" is a song by South Korean girl group Wonder Girls, from their debut album The Wonder Years (2007).

story.text: 처음 곡을 받은 멤버들은 너무 낯설어 성공하지 못할 것 같다고 느꼈다
story.quote: When producer Park Jin-young first introduced the song to the group, the Wonder Girls felt that the song was too different and would not be successful.

story.text: 따라 추기 쉬운 안무가 온라인 영상 사이트에서 널리 퍼졌다
story.quote: The song gained significant attention throughout South Korea for its choreography, which was widely imitated and featured on various online video sites.
It spent six non-consecutive weeks in the number one position on the domestic music program Music Bank

hintIdea.quote: A highlight of the song is an exclamation of surprise, "어머나!"

items.why: 처음엔 멤버들이 걱정했던 곡이 국민 유행 춤이 된 이야기

hintIdea.quote: 또한 그해 열린 제17회 골든 디스크 시상식에서는 대상을 수상하면서 혼성 그룹 최초 골든 디스크 대상 수상이라는 기록을 남겼다.
